action.name: reweight_training_samples
action.rationale: The model under-predicts the peak phase (as shown in exp-lambda-calendar-3-2025), so upweighting peak samples will force the model to prioritize accurate predictions during this critical phase.
action.expected_effect: Wis should decrease as the model focuses more on learning patterns during the peak phase, which currently contributes to under-prediction.

diagnosis.summary: The model exhibits significant underprediction bias and severe performance degradation at longer horizons, with peak phase predictions being particularly unreliable. Overall MAPE of 66.5% exceeds acceptable thresholds, and the worst individual predictions show errors exceeding -70%.

action.name: change_target_transform
action.rationale: The log transform compresses upper tails and may under-predict peaks, while raw transform allows better capture of peak values as hypothesized in the diagnosis
action.expected_effect: Reduced under-prediction during peak phases should lower WIS by improving prediction accuracy for high-value outcomes

diagnosis.summary: The model exhibits severe underprediction bias (-26.4) with MAPE exceeding 66%, particularly worsening with forecast horizon (week 4 MAPE 92.7%) and during peak phases (peak MAPE 47.7% but -58.8 bias). Critical failures occur in high-impact regions like New York and Florida during peak periods, with errors exceeding -76% in individual predictions.
